fields.label: Facility Level
fields.description: The facility's registry level, e.g. Level 2. Case and spacing are ignored.

fields.label: Flex Reward
fields.description: Tokens for a flat coupon, or % of purchased tokens for a percentage coupon. 0 gives nothing on Flex at this level.

fields.label: Fixed Plan Discount (%)
fields.description: Percentage off the Fixed package price at this level. 0 gives nothing on Fixed at this level.
